responsibility: Implements counting semaphores for the gm2 Processes runtime. It owns semaphore records, a reusable pool of semaphore and wait-list nodes, a circular queue of blocked processes ordered by urgency, and the logic that decrements counts, suspends callers, reactivates the highest-urgency waiting process on release, and supports nonblocking acquisition, thereby providing the synchronization primitive layered directly on ProcessId scheduling operations.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the Semaphores pair: it owns the concrete semaphore/process-list data structures and blocking/unblocking logic, whereas Semaphores.def presents only the abstract API and opaque type.
